description: This file defines a Java interface for interacting with the Notes API v1 in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It declares methods for CRUD operations on notes and settings, utilizing Retrofit annotations for HTTP requests.

classes.name: NotesAPI_1_0
classes.description: A Java interface defining the Notes API v1 endpoints for CRUD operations on notes and settings in the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes modified after a specified timestamp, with optional ETag filtering.

methods.name: getNotesIDs
methods.description: Retrieves IDs and metadata of notes excluding content and other detailed fields.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on the server.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its remote ID.

methods.name: editNote
methods.description: Edits an existing note identified by its remote ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its remote ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a note by its ID with new data.
